prompt.body:
@projmgrauth
Set repo: cl-events
Exact root: /home/user/code/lisp/cl-events
Canonical predecessor: CL-EVENTS-01-EVENTS-REFINE-20261014-R2

Act as a senior Common Lisp maintainer and independent reviewer. This is a review-first continuation of authorized enhancement work, not permission to duplicate a running implementation lane. Read exact predecessor prompt, packet, latest checkpoints, review verdicts, source diff, git status and path claims before doing work. Previously running OCP labels are not liveness: their browser targets disappeared in the current fleet. Do not replay the original send or complete partial tasks. Recover/adopt the exact predecessor using canonical evidence when supported; if no recovery is possible, report the exact failure and preserve work. For review use a separate eligible reviewer lease, never self-approve. Any implementation must get its own admitted bounded packet after old claims have released.

Independently review cancellation-registration unwind, deterministic concurrency and measured badge provenance. Prior worker reports 1677 checks and 1124/1301 executable lines (86.40%); verify at current hashes. Inspect select partial registration, cancellation precedence, task-scope sibling failure/reaping and promise terminal races with barriers and bounded joins. The consumer submodule is older; document exact commit divergence, do not update its pin in this lane.

Autonomy contract: implement necessary narrow corrections without asking about routine setup. Retain returned agentBinding, use transactional stale-write protection, renew claims, checkpoint transaction identity in the schema accepted by installed recovery tools, and submit typed phase evidence. If independent review finds remaining defects, create one idempotent, non-overlapping successor keyed by predecessor plus defect/source digest, publish/admit/dispatch through native OCP after required review. Include exact acceptance criteria, source paths, reproducer and result references. Continue while each phase makes measurable progress; stop at reviewed acceptance or an exact nonrecoverable blocker. Never repeat audit-only phases or self-prolong without an evidenced residual.

Coverage is executable line/expression counts, never assertion counts. Generate README badge from successful measured report with named metric, complete owned-source denominator, source hashes and CI provenance. Failed tests/gate invalidate new endpoint; never lower existing threshold or silently remove zero-covered sources. Distinguish local generated output from verified hosted availability. No pushes, releases, tags, history rewrites, cleanup or external publication are authorized.

Preserve unrelated dirty work, pinned consumer libraries and docs/release-history-purge.md deletion. Root capacity is four active workers; scoped styles/DSL/macros/terminal are serialized by admission and claims, final coverage task ELMTUI-CLPM-08-COVERAGE-REFINE-20261014-R2 owns root CI/README/coverage. Use the existing pending coverage task; do not create another coverage owner. Coordinate shared ASDF registration through its owner. Meaningful tests must fail before repairs and pass after; run affected full suites at stable hashes. Final evidence: commands/exit codes, pass/fail/skips, reviewed diff/source digest, measured counts, badge artifact, independent verdict, typed durable result and one precise remaining-work ledger.
prompt.title: 01-events independent review and autonomous gap closure
